title: Freed ID status-list cache-age, epoch-rollback, and revocation-window profile
hypothesis: A synthetic profile can reject stale or rolled-back credential-status material and calculate a bounded unresolved exposure window without producing production identity assurance.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate list purpose, status bit, issuer epoch, observed epoch, issued time, retrieval time, maximum cache age, failure policy, privacy class, and claim class; stale, rolled-back, ambiguous, or promoted rows must fail.
boundary: Structural or proxy acceptance is confined to the declared model. It does not promote empirical, participant, authority, production, security, accessibility, identity, or Stage 20 claims.
